name: P01-small-gaps-choice
why: Marcia's ruling of 2026-09-11 (small omissions → the team's choice), in the per-scene form she approved on 2026-09-21 (docs/ENSAIO-FINAL-SPEC.md §8.1): when a scene's telling is whole except for one or two small, concrete details — and this scene has already come back twice and each time a different small detail slipped — the guide names what was carried well, names the missing detail exactly, and OFFERS the team the choice: rehearse this scene once more, or go on and fix it in the Ensaio Final. Never on a first imperfect telling (that one is rehearsed again, fenced block and all); never for an addition, a filled silence, a protected order, a missing event or scene. The scene rehearsals arrive as the app sends them (the red microphone: the team's phrase-by-phrase translation behind the room-note). Rehearsal 1 drops the qualifier 'de passagem, como estrangeiro' (first imperfect telling → ensaiem de novo, no choice); rehearsal 2 restores it but drops the clan epithet 'efrateus de Belém de Judá' (a different small detail → the choice). Here the team chooses to REHEARSE ONCE MORE: the guide gives the fenced block and the one microphone instruction again, and the whole third rehearsal is accepted. The other road ('seguir e acertar no Ensaio Final', the reminder in the send-off) is played by P01-ensaio-final-send-off-a-small-gap. Ruling 2026-09-23 (prompts/guide_system_prompt.md, 'Opening a part — close it with these words') and Marcia's word that evening (the whole passage is not a part's opening): the team's request to rehearse scene 1, which it has heard only inside the whole passage (turn 2), is answered by opening that part, ending with her fixed closing and no fenced block (part_opening_closing); the fenced block comes on the team's 'Entendemos. Vamos pro ensaio.' (turn 3).

turns.team: Podemos começar. Conta a passagem inteira pra gente, devagar.
Entendemos. Vamos ensaiar a primeira cena na nossa língua.

pieces: Nos dias em que os juízes julgavam, teve uma fome na terra.
Um homem de Belém de Judá foi morar nos campos de Moabe com a mulher e os dois filhos.
O nome dele era Elimeleque, a mulher era Noemi, e os filhos Malom e Quiliom. Eram efrateus de Belém de Judá.
Chegaram nos campos de Moabe e ficaram lá.
Nos dias em que os juízes julgavam, teve uma fome na terra.
Um homem de Belém de Judá foi morar de passagem nos campos de Moabe, como estrangeiro, com a mulher e os dois filhos.
O nome dele era Elimeleque, a mulher era Noemi, e os filhos Malom e Quiliom.
Chegaram nos campos de Moabe e ficaram lá.

turns.team: A gente prefere ensaiar esta cena mais uma vez.
